name: Balance
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of just and honest measures as a reflection of God's character, condemning false balances as an abomination to the LORD (Proverbs 11:1; 20:23). The consistent theme of fairness and integrity in weights and balances reveals God's delight in righteousness and His sovereign oversight of all things (Leviticus 19:36; Proverbs 16:11). Additionally, the recognition of appropriate timing and seasons in life (Ecclesiastes 3:1) encourages believers to seek balance, particularly between their devotion to God and their daily responsibilities, fostering a life aligned with divine order and wisdom.
